inline bool isSep(char c) { return c == '\n' || c == '\r'; }

        buf[a] = static_cast<char>(y);

    if (buf == nullptr) {

        buf = static_cast<char*>(std::malloc(cap));
        if (buf == nullptr) return 1;
    }

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int n = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 100;
    std::vector<double> u(n), v(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) u[i] = 1.0;

        return 1.0 / ((i + j) * (i + j + 1) / 2 + i + 1);

            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += A(i, j) * u[j];
            v[i] = sum;

        // u = A^T * v
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += A(j, i) * v[j];
            u[i] = sum;
        }

    return 0;
}

// A[i][j] = 1 / ((i+j)*(i+j+1)/2 + i + 1) via the power method.

// Build: g++ -O2 -o spectral_norm spectral_norm.cpp

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

#pragma GCC optimize("O2")

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) return 1;

    const int n = std::atoi(argv[1]);
    if (n <= 0) {
        std::printf("0.000000000\n");
        return 0;
    }

    std::vector<double> u(n, 1.0), v(n, 0.0);

    // Precompute, for every anti-diagonal index k = i + j in [0, 2n):
    //   T[k] = k*(k+1)/2          (triangular number)
    //   G[k] = T[k] + k + 1
    // Then the matrix entries can be written as
    //   A(i,j) = 1 / (T[i+j] + i + 1)      (used for v = A*u)
    //   A(j,i) = 1 / (G[i+j] - i)          (used for u = A^T*v)
    // which keeps only a table load, an add and a division in the inner loops.
    const size_t m = static_cast<size_t>(2) * static_cast<size_t>(n);
    std::vector<double> T(m), G(m);
    for (size_t k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
        const double kk = static_cast<double>(k);
        const double t = kk * (kk + 1.0) / 2.0;   // exact: k*(k+1)/2 < 2^53
        T[k] = t;
        G[k] = t + kk + 1.0;
    }
    const double* const Tp = T.data();
    const double* const Gp = G.data();

    // 10 iterations of the power method (the standard benchmark setup):
    // start from u = 1 and alternate v = A*u, u = A^T*v.
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 10; ++iter) {
        // v = A * u
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const double base = static_cast<double>(i) + 1.0;
            const double* const Tk = Tp + i;
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += u[j] / (Tk[j] + base);
            v[i] = sum;
        }
        // u = A^T * v
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const double base = -static_cast<double>(i);
            const double* const Gk = Gp + i;
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += v[j] / (Gk[j] + base);
            u[i] = sum;
        }
    }

    double vBv = 0.0, vv = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        vBv += u[i] * v[i];
        vv += v[i] * v[i];
    }

    std::printf("%0.9f\n", std::sqrt(vBv / vv));
    return 0;
}

```cpp
// spectral-norm (Computer Language Benchmarks Game style)
//
// Estimates the spectral norm of the matrix with entries
//     A[i][j] = 1 / ((i+j)*(i+j+1)/2 + i + 1)
// by the power method: starting from u = 1, alternate
//     v = A*u  and  u = A^T*v
// ten times, then print sqrt((u·v)/(v·v)) with nine decimal places.
//
// Usage: ./spectral_norm N

#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__clang__)
#pragma GCC optimize("O3")
#endif

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) return 1;

    const long nlong = std::strtol(argv[1], nullptr, 10);
    if (nlong <= 0) {
        std::printf("0.000000000\n");
        return 0;
    }
    const int n = static_cast<int>(nlong < 2147483647L ? nlong : 2147483647L);

    std::vector<double> u(n, 1.0), v(n, 0.0);

    // Per anti-diagonal k = i + j (0 <= k <= 2n-2) precompute
    //   T[k] = k*(k+1)/2   and   G[k] = T[k] + k + 1,
    // so that
    //   A(i,j) = 1 / (T[i+j] + i + 1)     (for v = A*u)
    //   A(j,i) = 1 / (G[i+j] - i)         (for u = A^T*v)
    // and each inner-loop step is one table load, one add and one divide.
    const std::size_t m = static_cast<std::size_t>(n) * 2;
    std::vector<double> T(m), G(m);
    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
        const double kk = static_cast<double>(k);
        const double t = kk * (kk + 1.0) * 0.5;  // exact: k(k+1)/2 < 2^53
        T[k] = t;
        G[k] = t + kk + 1.0;
    }
    const double* const Tp = T.data();
    const double* const Gp = G.data();

    for (int iter = 0; iter < 10; ++iter) {
        // v = A * u
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const double base = static_cast<double>(i) + 1.0;
            const double* const Tk = Tp + i;
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += u[j] / (Tk[j] + base);
            v[i] = sum;
        }
        // u = A^T * v
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const double base = -static_cast<double>(i);
            const double* const Gk = Gp + i;
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) sum += v[j] / (Gk[j] + base);
            u[i] = sum;
        }
    }

    double vBv = 0.0, vv = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        vBv += u[i] * v[i];
        vv += v[i] * v[i];
    }

    std::printf("%0.9f\n", std::sqrt(vBv / vv));
    return 0;
}
```

Implementation with buffered output:

```cpp
static void writeWrappedRepeated(const char* src, size_t slen, size_t len) {
    size_t pos = 0; // position in src
    size_t remaining = len;
    char line[60];
    while (remaining > 0) {
        size_t linelen = remaining < 60 ? remaining : 60;
        // fill line from cyclic src
        size_t filled = 0;
        while (filled < linelen) {
            size_t chunk = slen - pos;
            if (chunk > linelen - filled) chunk = linelen - filled;
            memcpy(line + filled, src + pos, chunk);
            filled += chunk;
            pos += chunk;
            if (pos == slen) pos = 0;
        }
        append to output buffer: line (linelen chars) + '\n';
    }
}
```

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t IM = 139968;   // modulus
constexpr uint32_t IA = 3877;     // multiplier
constexpr uint32_t IC = 29573;    // increment

// The 287-character ALU sequence.
const char ALU[] =
    "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGA"
    "TCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACT"
    "AAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAG"
    "GCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCG"
    "CCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA";
constexpr size_t ALU_LEN = sizeof(ALU) - 1;

// Buffered stdout
constexpr size_t OUT_CAP = size_t(1) << 22;
char outbuf[OUT_CAP];
size_t outlen = 0;

inline void oflush() {
    if (outlen) {
        std::fwrite(outbuf, 1, outlen, stdout);
        outlen = 0;
    }
}

inline void oputs(const char* s) {
    const size_t len = std::strlen(s);
    if (outlen + len > OUT_CAP) oflush();
    std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, s, len);
    outlen += len;
}

// ---- Random generator (shared LCG) ----
constexpr int JUMP = 16;
uint32_t jumpA[JUMP + 1];
uint32_t jumpB[JUMP + 1];
uint8_t  symLUT[IM];
uint32_t lcgSeed = 42;

void initJump() {
    jumpA[0] = 1;
    jumpB[0] = 0;
    for (int j = 1; j <= JUMP; ++j) {
        jumpA[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpA[j - 1] * IA) % IM);
        jumpB[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpB[j - 1] * IA + IC) % IM);
    }
}

// symLUT[k] = symbol chosen for draw value k / IM
void buildSymLUT(const char* syms, const double* probs, int cnt) {
    double cum[16];
    double cp = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
        cp += probs[i];
        cum[i] = cp;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < IM; ++k) {
        const double r = (double)k / (double)IM;
        int j = 0;
        while (j < cnt - 1 && cum[j] <= r) ++j;
        symLUT[k] = (uint8_t)syms[j];
    }
}

// Generate `count` symbols, advancing the shared LCG.
void genRandom(char* dst, size_t count) {
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < count) {
        const size_t n = (count - done >= (size_t)JUMP) ? (size_t)JUMP : (count - done);
        const uint32_t base = lcgSeed;
        uint32_t s[JUMP];
        for (size_t j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
            s[j - 1] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)base * jumpA[j] + jumpB[j]) % IM);
        lcgSeed = s[n - 1];
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            dst[done + j] = (char)symLUT[s[j]];
        done += n;
    }
}

// ---- Writers ----
void writeAlu(long long total) {
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (total > 0) {
        if (outlen + 61 > OUT_CAP) oflush();
        const size_t linelen = (total >= 60) ? 60 : (size_t)total;
        total -= (long long)linelen;
        size_t filled = 0;
        while (filled < linelen) {
            size_t chunk = ALU_LEN - pos;
            const size_t need = linelen - filled;
            if (chunk > need) chunk = need;
            std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen + filled, ALU + pos, chunk);
            filled += chunk;
            pos += chunk;
            if (pos == ALU_LEN) pos = 0;
        }
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;
    }
}

void writeRandom(long long total) {
    char line[60];
    while (total > 0) {
        const size_t linelen = (total >= 60) ? 60 : (size_t)total;
        total -= (long long)linelen;
        genRandom(line, linelen);
        if (outlen + linelen + 1 > OUT_CAP) oflush();
        std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, line, linelen);
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;

}

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t IM = 139968;  // LCG modulus
constexpr uint32_t IA = 3877;    // LCG multiplier
constexpr uint32_t IC = 29573;   // LCG increment

// 287-character ALU sequence
const char ALU[] =
    "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGA"
    "TCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACT"
    "AAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAG"
    "GCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCG"
    "CCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA";
constexpr size_t ALU_LEN = sizeof(ALU) - 1;  // 287

// ---- buffered standard output ----
constexpr size_t OUT_CAP = size_t(1) << 22;
char outbuf[OUT_CAP];
size_t outlen = 0;

inline void oflush() {
    if (outlen) {
        std::fwrite(outbuf, 1, outlen, stdout);
        outlen = 0;
    }
}

inline void oputs(const char* s) {
    const size_t len = std::strlen(s);
    if (outlen + len > OUT_CAP) oflush();
    std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, s, len);
    outlen += len;
}

// ---- shared LCG: seed = (seed * IA + IC) mod IM ----
constexpr int JUMP = 16;
uint32_t jumpA[JUMP + 1];
uint32_t jumpB[JUMP + 1];
uint8_t symLUT[IM];
uint32_t lcgSeed = 42;

void initJump() {
    jumpA[0] = 1;
    jumpB[0] = 0;
    for (int j = 1; j <= JUMP; ++j) {
        jumpA[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpA[j - 1] * IA) % IM);
        jumpB[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpB[j - 1] * IA + IC) % IM);
    }
}

// symLUT[k] = symbol for draw value k / IM (first cum > r)
void buildSymLUT(const char* syms, const double* probs, int cnt) {
    double cum[16];
    double cp = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
        cp += probs[i];
        cum[i] = cp;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < IM; ++k) {
        const double r = (double)k / (double)IM;
        int j = 0;
        while (j < cnt - 1 && cum[j] <= r) ++j;
        symLUT[k] = (uint8_t)syms[j];
    }
}

// Generate `count` symbols advancing the shared LCG (block jump-ahead).
void genRandom(char* dst, size_t count) {
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < count) {
        const size_t n = (count - done >= (size_t)JUMP) ? (size_t)JUMP : (count - done);
        const uint32_t base = lcgSeed;
        uint32_t last = base;
        for (size_t j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            last = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)base * jumpA[j] + jumpB[j]) % IM);
            dst[done + j - 1] = (char)symLUT[last];
        }
        lcgSeed = last;
        done += n;
    }
}

void writeAlu(long long total) {
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (total > 0) {
        if (outlen + 61 > OUT_CAP) oflush();
        const size_t linelen = (total >= 60) ? 60 : (size_t)total;
        total -= (long long)linelen;
        size_t filled = 0;
        while (filled < linelen) {
            size_t chunk = ALU_LEN - pos;
            const size_t need = linelen - filled;
            if (chunk > need) chunk = need;
            std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen + filled, ALU + pos, chunk);
            filled += chunk;
            pos += chunk;
            if (pos == ALU_LEN) pos = 0;
        }
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;
    }
}

void writeRandom(long long total) {
    alignas(64) char line[60];
    while (total > 0) {
        const size_t linelen = (total >= 60) ? 60 : (size_t)total;
        total -= (long long)linelen;
        genRandom(line, linelen);
        if (outlen + linelen + 1 > OUT_CAP) oflush();
        std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, line, linelen);
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;
    }
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) return 1;
    const long long n = std::strtoll(argv[1], nullptr, 10);

    writeAlu(2 * n);

    oputs(">TWO IUB ambiguity codes\n");
    writeRandom(3 * n);

    buildSymLUT(hsSyms, hsProbs, 4);
    oputs(">THREE Homo sapiens frequency\n");

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t IM = 139968;  // LCG modulus
constexpr uint32_t IA = 3877;    // LCG multiplier
constexpr uint32_t IC = 29573;   // LCG increment

// 287-character ALU sequence
const char ALU[] =
    "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGA"
    "TCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACT"
    "AAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAG"
    "GCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCG"
    "CCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA";
static_assert(sizeof(ALU) - 1 == 287, "ALU string must be 287 characters");
constexpr size_t ALU_LEN = sizeof(ALU) - 1;

// ---- buffered standard output ----
constexpr size_t OUT_CAP = size_t(1) << 22;
char outbuf[OUT_CAP];
size_t outlen = 0;

inline void oflush() {
    if (outlen) {
        std::fwrite(outbuf, 1, outlen, stdout);
        outlen = 0;
    }
}

inline void oputs(const char* s) {
    const size_t len = std::strlen(s);
    if (outlen + len > OUT_CAP) oflush();
    std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, s, len);
    outlen += len;
}

// ---- shared LCG: seed = (seed * IA + IC) mod IM, starting at 42 ----
constexpr int JUMP = 16;
uint32_t jumpA[JUMP + 1];
uint32_t jumpB[JUMP + 1];
uint8_t symLUT[IM];
uint32_t lcgSeed = 42;

void initJump() {
    jumpA[0] = 1;
    jumpB[0] = 0;
    for (int j = 1; j <= JUMP; ++j) {
        jumpA[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpA[j - 1] * IA) % IM);
        jumpB[j] = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)jumpB[j - 1] * IA + IC) % IM);
    }
}

// symLUT[k] = symbol selected for draw value k / IM
// (first symbol whose cumulative probability is strictly greater than r)
void buildSymLUT(const char* syms, const double* probs, int cnt) {
    double cum[16];
    double cp = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
        cp += probs[i];
        cum[i] = cp;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < IM; ++k) {
        const double r = (double)k / (double)IM;
        int j = 0;
        while (j < cnt - 1 && cum[j] <= r) ++j;
        symLUT[k] = (uint8_t)syms[j];
    }
}

// Generate `count` symbols, advancing the shared LCG state.
void genRandom(char* dst, size_t count) {
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < count) {
        const size_t n =
            (count - done >= (size_t)JUMP) ? (size_t)JUMP : (count - done);
        const uint32_t base = lcgSeed;
        uint32_t last = base;
        for (size_t j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            // f^j(base) = (base * A_j + B_j) mod IM
            last = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)base * jumpA[j] + jumpB[j]) % IM);
            dst[done + j - 1] = (char)symLUT[last];
        }
        lcgSeed = last;
        done += n;
    }
}

// ---- sequence writers (wrap at 60 columns) ----
void writeAlu(long long total) {
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (total > 0) {
        if (outlen + 61 > OUT_CAP) oflush();
        const size_t linelen = (total >= 60) ? 60 : (size_t)total;
        total -= (long long)linelen;
        size_t filled = 0;
        while (filled < linelen) {
            size_t chunk = ALU_LEN - pos;
            const size_t need = linelen - filled;
            if (chunk > need) chunk = need;
            std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen + filled, ALU + pos, chunk);
            filled += chunk;
            pos += chunk;
            if (pos == ALU_LEN) pos = 0;
        }
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;
    }
}

    while (total > 0) {

        std::memcpy(outbuf + outlen, line, linelen);
        outbuf[outlen + linelen] = '\n';
        outlen += linelen + 1;
    }
}
